files.description: Playwright tests for the themes page: system/custom listing with default marker, AI-assisted creation (simulated agent), rename with slug re-derivation, publish/discard of an injected draft verified through the served CSS, default switching applied app-wide, and confirmed deletion.

testContext: /themes redirects to the default theme. Sidebar .themes-sidebar: 'System'/'Custom' h3 headings each followed by ul.panel-nav; the default theme carries a .theme-nav-default badge (exactly one). Seeded custom theme: 'Test Ocean' (slug test-ocean). Create via #new-theme-button -> #newThemeModal (#new-theme-label); the redirect URL carries the slug. Custom-only actions: #rename-theme-button -> #renameThemeModal (#rename-theme-label pre-filled; rename re-derives the slug and redirects), #delete-theme-button -> #global-confirm-dialog then a hidden form POST; system themes render neither button. 'Make default' posts /themes/<slug>/default and answers HX-Refresh; html[data-theme] changes app-wide (assert on another page) — RESTORE the original default afterwards. Chat: same shared chat-dialog as automations (#theme-chat-* ids, 1.5s polls, terminal non-FAILED status reloads); the sandbox has no AI key so intercept POST /themes/<slug>/chat (202) and GET /themes/<slug>/status (2 IN_PROGRESS polls then READY) and register waitForEvent('load') BEFORE submitting. A real draft never exists after a simulated run, so publish/discard is reached by INJECTING a READY working draft directly into the ApplicationSettings row custom_theme:<slug> (JSON asdict(CustomTheme): set status='READY' and working_theme={tokens_css with [data-theme="slug"] block, skin_css, favicon_svg, placeholder_svg}) via ../venv/bin/python + stdlib sqlite3 against the sandbox DB (path from Settings System Information). The draft panel (.theme-draft, 'unpublished design') offers 'Save draft' (publish -> HX-Refresh, then /themes/<slug>/preview.css serves the promoted tokens) and 'Discard' (draft dropped, published CSS unchanged). NOTE: preview.css serves the DRAFT while one is pending, the published CSS otherwise — only read it when no draft pends. Theme records are global state: every created theme is deleted (afterAll POSTs /themes/<slug>/delete for leftovers) and the default is restored in a finally.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/themes.yaml after inspecting templates/themes_page/index.html, routes/themes_page.py, static/themes_page/index.js, yaffo/themes.py (CustomTheme/ThemeAssets persistence as JSON in ApplicationSettings), routes/base.py (preview.css draft behavior), and scripts/seed_database.py (Test Ocean). Validated with typecheck and a green run (6/6) against the isolated environment.
